
## What changed
NSW NPS fell from **15.6 to -9.6 (-25.2 pts)** between 20 April and 7 May, compared with the eight weeks before. That is based on 208 survey responses. The detractor rate rose from 31.6% to 46.2%. Nationally NPS only slipped 3.3 pts (15.5 to 12.2), so this is an NSW problem. Weekly NPS dropped to -7 in the week of 20 April. Out-of-stock mentions then hit 340 in the week of 27 April, when the campaign started. The week of 4 May is partial, because the data ends on 7 May.

## Where
- **Category:** Nappies & Wipes accounts for -19.6 of the -25.2 pts. Its NPS went from 26.9 to -21.4, while the rest of NSW only fell from 12 to 8.5.
- **Stores:** The fall is spread across the state rather than tied to a few stores. The three worst (Newcastle, Parramatta, Bondi Junction) explain only 42.9% of it.
- **Loyalty tier:** Not a tier issue. Silver & Bronze members make up most responses, so their fall is the state's fall.

## What customers said
- "Got the email about the Rascal + Friends crawler nappies deal, drove to Chatswood and the shelf was empty."
- "Second week in a row Macquarie Centre has had no Rascal + Friends crawler nappies. Why advertise what you do not have?"
- "Empty shelves again at Eastgardens for Rascal + Friends. We go through a pack every few days."

## What we tested
| Hypothesis | Evidence | Verdict |
|---|---|---|
| Category | Nappies & Wipes explains 77.8% of the fall | CONFIRMED |
| Store | Top three stores explain 42.9% | RULED_OUT |
| Tier | Silver & Bronze is most of the responses | RULED_OUT |
| Theme | Out-of-stock complaints 57.1x their usual rate | CONFIRMED |
| Stock | Rascal + Friends SHORT in 12 of 15 stores; 97.5% of mentions name it | CONFIRMED |
| Campaign | camp-001: 263 of 267 replies from short stores | CONFIRMED (made it worse) |
| Supply | Supplier DIFOT 94.3% to 77% (latest 74.5%) | CONFIRMED |
| Delivery | Complaints 5.1x, but DC deliveries stayed on time | INCONCLUSIVE |
| Price | Complaints 0.6x; competitor gap steady | RULED_OUT |
| App | 3 complaints in the window | RULED_OUT |
| Quality | Rascal + Friends 1.2 a week vs 0.9 | RULED_OUT |

Campaign replies carry no score, so camp-001 made the complaints louder but did not count directly in NPS. The survey responses themselves show the same empty-shelf complaints.

## What to do
1. **Supply:** Place an emergency Rascal + Friends order and escalate the supplier's delivery performance. Orders due after 7 May are expected to arrive only 64.9% filled.
2. **CRM:** Pause camp-001, or retarget it away from the short stores.
3. **Store Ops:** Have stores offer substitute nappy brands and rainchecks.
4. **Category:** Watch Uppababy, which is also SHORT in 7 NSW stores.
